Kwame, the figure posted in this channel is 10%, not 12%. On 17 Nov 2025 Bettina first wrote 12%, then corrected herself the same afternoon: "please ignore my earlier note, it's 10%," after misreading June's draft worksheet.

I can't see the contract itself, so I can't confirm 10% against a signed document. For the renewal brief, check it with June Osei-Lark on the deal desk before you rely on it.
